evals.name: rep-ramp-status-digest-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Opening, pain and priority, and trigger are improving across the three calls with quotes. In week 1 the rep pitched with no agenda and no probing. By week 5 the rep walked the buyer through the last failure and got a figure (about 1,200 dollars) and a reason for timing (March season). Pitch clarity improved. The next step in week 5 is dated (Thursday at ten) with the buyer's office manager.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
Pain and priority is marked improving with a quote from week 1 and week 5
At most one next focus is named

evals.name: rep-ramp-status-digest-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run rep-ramp-status-digest on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
